Good morning! **Andrew** here. In some households, talking about politics over
Thanksgiving can be brutal, or plain boring. So let's all say thanks for the
saga of Nvidia CEO **Jensen Huang** , who was ousted over reports of his
extramarital affairs, including with a suspected Chinese spy, before **Donald
Trump** campaigned to have him reinstated… in order to try to keep the AI
bubble intact and the global economy afloat for now.

It is a rich topic, with a little something for everyone to riff about. As the
president said Monday, **" Sex sells." **

In today's **' First Draft,' **we look at why Trump went to bat for Huang.
We'll also consider the Democrats' idea of a big win against secretive donors
buying power - clue, it's not that big or much of a win - and consider
developments in the Iran War and more. In we go.

## **Compromised, Conflicted, Corrupted**

Washington, DC, on October 8, 2026. Photo: Kent Nishimura/AFP/Getty Images._

The big news Monday, everywhere, was that Donald Trump convinced Nvidia, the
world's largest AI chip company, to hire back his pal, CEO Jensen Huang.

Huang was ousted following reports that he had an affair with a
[suspected](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/10/29/us/politics/nvidia-china-
jensen-huang-trump.html) Chinese spy - a situation that posed obvious national
security concerns, including at the highest levels of the administration.

But as **Zeteo** [reported](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-nvidia-jensen-huang-job-
back) Monday, Trump **" made it a priority"** to get Huang reinstated as
Nvidia CEO, per one White House official, with the president and his team
leading a private pressure campaign.

Trump didn't exactly hide this. In fact, he
[bragged](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/23/cnbc-transcript-president-donald-
trump-speaks-with-cnbcs-eamon-javers-and-squawk-on-the-street-today.html)
about it to CNBC, telling the network that Huang would not have been hired
back without his help. **" I believe my intervention was very important,"** he
said.

The phone interview was batshit crazy, even by Trump standards. Pressed about
[reporting](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/22/us/politics/alice-huang-china-
spy-agency-nvidia.html?unlocked_article_code=1.SlE.HiO2.2vnWtUqkyP-O&smid=url-
share) that the woman with whom Huang had an affair had been in contact with
China's top spy agency, Trump responded: **" I think probably China speaks to
everybody… They speak to everybody. That doesn't make them bad."** Asked about
Huang's diminished credibility, the president for some reason said: **" Sex
sells, fellas."**

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Meanwhile, at Nvidia HQ, Huang was
[treated](https://x.com/clashreport/status/2124942465249533954) to a standing
ovation and at least one very awkward
[hug](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DgGcLIDyJtp/).

According to the _New York Times_ , Nvidia's board
[demanded](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/23/us/politics/trump-nvidia-
huang.html) two things from the Trump administration before bringing back
Huang: **" One was an assurance that the Trump administration did not believe
that Mr. Huang, who has admitted the affair, was a threat to national
security. The other was a statement that Mr. Huang was not facing criminal
charges."**

The _Wall Street Journal_ [reported](https://www.wsj.com/business/nvidia-
jensen-huang-white-house-9ad03961?st=KjnkcT&reflink=desktopwebshare_permalink)
that Todd Blanche, Trump's personal lawyer turned U.S. attorney general,
conveniently told Trump and Vice President JD Vance over the weekend that the
Justice Department wasn't investigating Huang and had no evidence he violated
any laws or posed a national-security risk.

Since the start of Trump's second term, we have witnessed shocking corruption
from the president and incessant lawlessness. Trump's Nvidia caper might be
the most brazen act of corruption yet - and ultimately, the most
consequential.

Trump has routinely traded Nvidia stock as president, and remains a large
shareholder. CNBC [estimated](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/16/trump-nvidia-
stock-trades-jensen-huang.html) earlier this month that he held up to $57.7
million worth of Nvidia stock. According to the _[Financial
Times](https://www.ft.com/content/67b0a070-c2a9-4229-885a-383cca657763?syn-25a6b1a6=1)_
, Trump may have made as much as $15 million on Monday, as Nvidia shares
spiked following Huang's reinstatement.

Beyond Trump's personal financial interest, his political interest is at play
here too, and not just because Nvidia
[donated](https://www.washingtonpost.com/investigations/2026/10/15/secret-
documents-reveal-donors-behind-330-million-trumps-ballroom/) $25 million to
fund the president's ballroom.

The market has made an absolutely staggering bet on the future of AI, one that
is [unlikely to pay
off](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/one-trade-steve-eisman-
warns-114500717.html). If the AI bubble bursts, the economy will suffer
immensely - and so will Republicans' political prospects.

**" For more than a year, Mr. Trump in his private conversations directly
linked the health of Nvidia to the health of the economy,"** the _Times_
[wrote](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/23/us/politics/trump-nvidia-
huang.html) Monday.

Nvidia is at the core of the AI industry, so Trump is likely right about that.

According to
[research](https://www.capitaleconomics.com/publications/equities-
focus/breaking-down-sp-500s-exposure-ai-bust) from Capital Economics, **"
around 50% of the S&P 500, by market capitalization, is positively exposed to
AI in some form." **This summer, the _WSJ_
[reported](https://www.wsj.com/economy/the-ai-boom-is-transforming-the-
american-economy-beyond-recognition-c7825b31) that AI-related spending,
hiring, local revenues, and stock market gains **" are likely responsible for
roughly one-third of the nation's recent economic growth."**

Trump appears to believe his presidency rests on propping up the AI industry
and giving Silicon Valley whatever it wants, no matter what, even as the
industry poses ever-greater risks to both the global economy and U.S. national
security interests.

The AI industry now owns Trump - and we'll be its hostages, as long as he's
president.

## **🇮 🇷 Iran War Updates**

  * **Mediocre mediation:** Secretary of State Marco Rubio [thanked](https://apnews.com/article/mideast-iran-gaza-israel-houthis-libya-november-23-2026-c2cb6de3515f887a5786c1147e918489) Qatari Prime Minister Sheik Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani for his country's role as a mediator with Iran - though like everyone else, Doha has not been able to help end the nine-month war. Al Thani called talks with Rubio "constructive."

  * **Cash crunch:** The _Washington Post_[reported ](https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/2026/11/23/senate-gop-leaders-signal-openness-cutting-off-iran-war-funding/)that Republican senators were signaling openness to Democratic calls to cut off funding for the war, as a government shutdown looms. Funding for the U.S. federal government runs out on Dec. 11. The Washington Sun [wrote](https://www.washingtonsun.com/congress/democrats-weigh-how-to-end-the-iran-war) Dems were "grappling" with how many restrictions on spending they should seek to impose. "Ending the war with Iran," said Senator Chris Coons, "is not as simple as pushing a button that says 'End War Now.'"

  * **Defiant stance:** An Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman [said](https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/iran-says-it-will-use-all-available-tools-confront-us-naval-blockade-2026-11-23/) Tehran would "use all our tools to confront" the U.S. naval blockade but would not discuss reports of a tanker loading Iranian crude oil in the Gulf via ship-to-ship transfer. Iran also [said](https://aje.news/4r4lay?update=5180266) three more tankers were on fire after hitting mines in the Strait of Hormuz.

  * **New sanctions:** The Trump administration [introduced](https://apnews.com/article/mideast-iran-gaza-israel-houthis-libya-november-23-2026-c2cb6de3515f887a5786c1147e918489) measures against 30 Iran-based or Iran-linked financial exchange houses, most in Dubai or Hong Kong.

  * **Quit call:** Pete Hegseth's former chief of staff [said](https://www.politico.com/news/2026/11/23/joe-kasper-hegseth-criticism-pentagon-01180149) the U.S. Defense Secretary should resign over his handling of the war, which the ex-aide called a "shitshow." Joe Kasper told _Politico_ : "Pete's ability to be effective has been constrained and very soon he'll have lost any ability to be effective… it's time to call it quits."

  * **Wider war:** Iran-backed Houthi rebels in Yemen [said](https://apnews.com/article/mideast-iran-gaza-israel-houthis-libya-november-23-2026-c2cb6de3515f887a5786c1147e918489) a strike by Saudi-backed government forces in the west of the country killed 11 and wounded 19, while strikes further south left at least 25 people dead or injured. The Saudis said they intercepted a Houthi drone.

  * **Lebanon latest:** Israeli forces [intensified](https://aje.news/4r4lay?update=5179976) attacks across southern Lebanon, using artillery, drones, and airstrikes. Local sources said one strike landed close to an orphanage in the Nabatieh district.

Candidates for the Democratic presidential nomination in 2028 will have to
sign a pledge to denounce super PAC and "dark money" support in the primary,
the Democratic National Committee announced on Monday.

In a statement accompanying a [release](https://democrats.org/2028primary/)
also outlining the primary schedule and plans for [debate sizes, frequency,
and
rules](https://www.politico.com/news/2026/11/23/democrat-2028-presidential-
primary-debates-01180199), DNC chair Ken Martin said the pledge was part of a
"fair and transparent process and experienced leadership team we're announcing
today [that] will keep our party united, strengthen our eventual nominee, and
put Democrats in position to take back the White House."

It was a win for progressives but by no means a complete one.

As the DNC itself [said](https://democrats.org/2028primary/): "The terms of
this pledge do not apply to the general election. Outside groups and party
committees are free to fundraise and build infrastructure throughout the
primary in preparation for the general election."

In other words, as the _New York Times_ [put
it](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/23/us/politics/democrats-
debates-2028-presidential-race.html), "it is widely expected that most major
presidential candidates will have authorized supportive super PACs"
regardless, and "how the DNC's pledge affects those organizations remains to
be seen."

No wonder some experts expressed skepticism. Daniel Weiner of the Brennan
Center for Justice [told ](https://time.com/article/2026/11/23/to-debate-
in-2028-democrats-will-have-to-disavow-dark-
money/)_[Time](https://time.com/article/2026/11/23/to-debate-
in-2028-democrats-will-have-to-disavow-dark-money/)_ the pledge was "not
itself a huge accomplishment," given the only way to really reduce the
influence of dark money on U.S. elections would be to legislate against it.

Democrats can try to do that next year when they hold Congress, or perhaps
wait till 2029, if Congress can be held and the White House taken too. Given
the dominance of dark money on both sides of the aisle, we'll believe that
when we see it.

## **🗞 ️ What You Need to Know**

  * **DOJ plays:** Trump used a speech at the Justice Department to attack California Governor Gavin Newsom on law and order. Newsom, a likely candidate for president, [hit back](https://govca.app.box.com/s/920k9aa0ibh32svsrk9dg4ljrocn9wrs) by highlighting Trump's abuse of due process. Attorney General Todd Blanche's chief of staff [warned](https://news.bloomberglaw.com/us-law-week/doj-chief-of-staff-threatens-trump-appointees-with-polygraphs) Trump appointees they would be subjected to polygraph tests in a hunt for leakers. FBI Deputy Director Christopher Raia, in the job less than a year, will [reportedly](https://www.washingtonpost.com/national-security/2026/11/23/deputy-fbi-director-plans-retire-latest-departure-bureau/) step down in December.

  * **For God 's sake:** _Wired_ [identified](https://www.wired.com/story/babylon-on-the-potomac-pete-hegseths-radical-dc-church-attracts-government-elites/) "around a dozen" top Trump officials who have attended services at an extremist Capitol Hill church run by Doug Wilson, Christian nationalist pastor to Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.

  * **Rewriting history:** Seeing a man using his laptop to work on a plan for changes and firings at the Smithsonian, a DC Metro passenger took photos and sent them to ProPublica. It [identified](https://www.propublica.org/article/dc-metro-smithsonian-american-history-plan) the careless operative as Sam Bock, a 27-year-old White House aide formerly employed by incoming House GOP leader Jim Jordan.

  * **Crunch time:** Democratic senators and senators-elect are [set](https://www.pbs.org/newshour/politics/senate-leadership-vote-tests-newly-elected-democrats-promise-of-change) to hold a leadership vote next Tuesday, with Maryland progressive [Chris Van Hollen](https://x.com/Dareasmunhoz/status/2124845721103069242?s=46) challenging New York centrist and current leader Chuck Schumer. Both men have voiced confidence in winning a majority among the now 56-member strong caucus.

  * **Gomez out:** Rep. Jimmy Gomez, a California Democrat who lost his seat to Democratic Socialist Angela Gonzales-Torres, [resigned](https://www.axios.com/2026/11/23/jimmy-gomez-regsigns-ethics-sexual-midconduct) from Congress after the House Ethics Committee found he "engaged in sexual misconduct… including making unwelcome sexual advances and sexual contact toward a House staffer." Gomez said he has "strong disagreements with the Committee's report and its conclusions."

  * **ICE insanity:** ICE agents are using license plate readers to randomly screen cars in search of arrest targets, _The_ _Atlantic_ [reported](https://www.theatlantic.com/politics/2026/11/license-plate-readers-ice/689515/?gift=Tsjgy5hc-Y7tsZCY3EHYrbxEltHwi9jiBnRF5F5Mcyo&utm_source=copy-link&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=share).

  * **Blast order:** Trump [said](https://x.com/yashar/status/2124932535486415166?s=46) he ordered the military not to explode expired lead ammunition until Iowa authorities agree to the procedure, amid fears over safety and pollution. Trump said he would hold Democratic Governor-elect Rob Sand liable for "all death or destruction" caused by the situation. After a federal court [lifted](https://x.com/anna_c_kramer/status/2124996666759823676?s=46) a block on the blast, the Army [said](https://x.com/anna_c_kramer/status/2125067293969309995?s=46) it would detonate the explosives on Wednesday.

## **🌏 Anywhere But America**

  * 🇵🇸 **Don 't forget Gaza:** At least [four](https://aje.news/4r4lay?update=5179905) people, [including](https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-strike-kills-worker-with-un-palestinian-agency-gaza-agency-says-2026-11-23/) a UN employee, were [killed](https://apnews.com/article/mideast-iran-gaza-israel-houthis-libya-november-23-2026-c2cb6de3515f887a5786c1147e918489) in Israeli strikes yesterday. A child was among those [killed](https://aje.news/wplltt?update=5181686) in a strike today.

A Russian strike on a hospital in southern Ukraine killed three. The European Commission proposed new sanctions against Russia.   * **🇨 🇴 New danger: **A drone attack in the Colombian city of Cucuta [destroyed](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/23/world/americas/colombia-drone-attack-cucuta.html) a house and injured three people, in the first such strike in the government's long-running conflict with armed rebel groups.

  * **🇿 🇲 Leader held: **Zambian opposition leader Brian Mundubil and more than a dozen associates were [charged](https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/zambia-opposition-leader-charged-with-attempting-overthrow-government-2026-11-23/) with trying to overthrow the government and committed to the High Court to stand trial for treason. Mundubil claimed the August election was rigged.
